rules.title: San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance (housing)
rules.requirement: Limits how housing providers may use arrest or conviction history when making decisions about affordable housing. This page gives only a one-line summary and does not state the specific procedures or limits.
rules.key_value: Restricts use of arrest/conviction history in affordable housing decisions
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to affordable housing decisions only, per this page's summary.
rules.quoted_span: San Francisco's Fair Chance Ordinance protects residents with arrest or conviction history in affordable housing decisions.
